intraday_lane.why: Khalid, 2026-10-21: Polygon should keep refreshing my data so I get fresh data during market hours Monday through Friday. The light Polygon feeds (live snapshot / quote endpoints, 0.2-12 s runs) are fanned out every five minutes 09:00-16:55 New York time, Monday-Friday, by one EventBridge Scheduler schedule (the clock change follows the America/New_York timezone). Their daily triggers stay as they are (the post-close / pre-market consolidation run). About $1-2 of Lambda a month for the whole lane; the $50/engine cap and the anomaly sentinel (200 invocations or $1 per hourly window) stay in force. The stocks tape is 15-minute delayed on the current Massive/Polygon plan; real-time needs the Advanced tier.

rule: readers fire after their writers: no reader inside a writer's margin, none within 60 min before it; pullers after their provider's print, no provider burst over its slot cap
